title: Smile and Portrait
author: Theo Quintana
blurb: Kestrel Okafor, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
